note: The PLAN.md 5.3 surface, expressed as blocks. The full cross product of the seven listed factors is 96768 cells x 1000 reps = 97 million replicates, which is not a design anyone can run or read, and a one-factor-at-a-time sweep would leave the interactions unmeasured. Each block below is a full cross product over the factors it names at a stated background, so every level of every factor appears and the interactions inside each block are measured. WHAT IS NOT COVERED: the cross-block interactions (in particular DA proportion x sample count at large taxon counts, and library size x sparsity) are not estimated, and no block varies more than four factors at once. Per-cell Monte-Carlo error at 1000 reps and 50 DA taxa is about 0.016 on power, so the 3 SE acceptance band is roughly 0.05 wide; cells with fewer DA taxa cannot resolve it and are reported as inconclusive rather than as agreement.
